'''Suribran Tu's regime''' was the autocratic government of [[Tibrin/Legends|Tibrin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The regime was led by [[Suribran Tu]], who was seen by [[Ishi Tib/Legends|his people]] as a butcher for ordering the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of dissidents. Despite its repression it was supported by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], but was [[Tibrin revolution|dismantled]] by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and his [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
